notes.title: Sokoball Dreams Launch
notes.content:
Thanks you all who playtested and wishlisted Sokoball Dreams! After 4 months of development, it is getting launched at March 1st!

Sokoball Dreams is a remake of my first game called "Sokobin" launched on Android around 2013 with the same catch of interacting with the blocks instead of controlling a physical character. Unfortunatelly the game is no longer available and I've managed to lose the source code ːsteamsadː and had to redo all from scratch. I took the oportunity to add more challenges and mechanics.

Here is how the game looked, it followed the original Sokoban push box into places idea. It was a huge success at the time with thousands of players and good reviews!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343330/8c6ae59edf8391d4b4d8abe2f6457407dc48a053.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy Sokoball Dreams puzzles!
